project.name: KINGXFORD campaign-first website
project.objective: Establish a new St. John's advertising agency as credible, distinctive, and ready to win serious launch and growth briefs across Canada.
project.audience: Canadian founders, marketing leaders, public-interest teams, tourism and hospitality operators, and technology companies evaluating an agency partner on desktop or mobile.
project.governing_idea: Show one commercial idea becoming a complete campaign in one continuous take.

creative_system.visual_thesis: A tactile campaign room moves from evidence to image to distribution; Atlantic character is expressed through material, light, and decisiveness rather than nautical symbolism.
anti_goals: giant typography used as a substitute for proof
generic glass, neon, or glowing-network aesthetics
fabricated client work, testimonials, or results
long scroll spectacle before the visitor understands the offer

palette.contrast: dark cinematic opening followed by high-contrast editorial campaign rooms

creative_system.composition: One clear focal point per viewport, asymmetric editorial grids, useful negative space, and immediate work proof.
creative_system.camera: A grounded forward move from studio to market with no scroll interception.
creative_system.lighting: North Atlantic blue ambient light balanced by warm practical sources and truthful material response.
creative_system.typography: Readable editorial display type with compact monospaced production labels and restrained uppercase use.
creative_system.motion: A finite 190svh desktop and 165svh mobile scroll scrub with opening and closing holds, freeze control, skip path, and static fallback.
creative_system.sound: Silent by design for immediate, non-disruptive web use.
creative_system.interface: Keyboard-accessible controls, visible focus, touch-ready study selection, responsive reflow, reduced-motion parity, and semantic HTML copy.
invariants: Every campaign study is explicitly disclosed as independent concept work.
The primary offer and calls to action are visible on the first film frame.
Mobile receives purpose-cropped frames and a shorter composition rather than a scaled desktop page.
permitted_variations: Study accent colours and image crops may change while disclosure, information hierarchy, and interaction remain consistent.
